hash_semantics: SHA256 of actual workspace files at initial scan before this expansion; not a claim that all were clean Git blobs or still have the same bytes after this task
method: All tracked Markdown headings and keyword-matched problem contexts, all baseline commit subjects, then focused report/specification reads and source/result cross-checks. A family mapping is navigation, not evidence that every sentence was exhaustively reviewed.
exclusions: No replay of historical paid model or business writes
Untracked raw logs, database snapshots and user assets not ingested or changed
Missing or undocumented historical attempts not reconstructed
